newsitem.title: SPAIN: Clintons relax on royal yacht of Spain's king.
newsitem.headline: Clintons relax on royal yacht of Spain's king.

text.p: PALMA de MALLORCA, Spain, U.S. President Bill Clinton and his wife Hillary joined Spain's king and queen on Sunday on the royal yacht Fortuna for an outing on the clear blue waters of the Mediterranean Sea.
The Clintons set out at noon with King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sofia on the sleek white yacht, followed by a small high speed boat containing U.S. Secret Service agents.

At one point, the royal vessel passed the USS Hue City, an aegis class cruiser, which had U.S. sailors lining the railing to catch of glimpse of their commander-in-chief. Clinton saluted and waved to the crew.
Clinton, who arrived in Majorca on Saturday, planned to remain on this resort island until Monday when he flies to Madrid for a NATO summit that starts the next day.
On Saturday night the Clintons toured Palma de Mallorca Cathedral, a towering Gothic style church that dominates the city's skyline.
